title: Walking in God's Light and Confessing Sin
summary_text: The writer proclaims the Word of life, whom he and the other witnesses heard, saw, and touched. They announce the eternal life revealed to them so their readers can share fellowship with the Father and Jesus Christ. Those who deny their sin deceive themselves, but God is faithful to forgive those who confess and cleanse them from unrighteousness.

title: Remain in Christ and Love One Another
summary_text: Jesus Christ, the Righteous One, speaks for those who sin and is the atoning sacrifice for the whole world's sins. Those who know Him keep His commandments and love others. The writer tells his readers their sins are forgiven, then warns them against the world's passing desires and pride. Antichrists deny that Jesus is the Christ, but the readers must keep the truth they first heard. Their anointing teaches them to stay in Christ, who promises eternal life, and to await His coming without shame.
key_points: Jesus speaks for those who sin and is the atoning sacrifice for their sins and those of the whole world.
Obeying His commandments and loving fellow believers show knowledge of Him and life in the light.

Antichrists deny the Father and Son; readers must hold to the truth and the promise of eternal life.

title: God's Children Practice Righteousness and Active Love
summary_text: The Father's love makes believers His children, who hope to become like Christ when He appears. Sin is lawlessness, and the Son of God came to remove sins and destroy the devil's works; those born of God do not keep practicing sin. Righteousness and love distinguish God's children from the devil's children, while hatred follows Cain's example and belongs to death. Jesus gave His life for them, so love must include costly action and help for those in need. God knows their hearts, hears their requests as they obey, and gives His Spirit as assurance that He remains in them.

title: Test the Spirits and Love One Another
summary_text: The writer warns against false prophets and calls for testing spirits by whether they confess Jesus Christ coming in the flesh. God's presence in the believers is greater than the power in the world, and those who know God listen to His witnesses. God is love, shown by sending His Son as the atoning sacrifice for sins and the world's Savior. His Spirit and confession of Jesus as the Son of God give assurance of living in Him, while complete love drives out fear of judgment. The letter rejects any claim to love God while hating a fellow believer.

title: Eternal Life Is in God's Son
